name.description: Catalog name, typically the application or service.
Entity name; unique within the catalog.

owner.description: Team or component responsible for the entity.

subject_key.description: SubjectKey names the field that identifies the data subject.

privacy_scope.description: PrivacyScope marks the entity as subject to access and erasure requests.

hold_applicable.description: HoldApplicable marks the entity as subject to legal holds. It is an entity-level property: holds suspend erasure for whole rows.

versioned.description: Versioned marks the entity as keeping row history. It is an entity-level property: history rows must be erased with their subject.

retention.description: Retention is a free-text retention note.

name.description: Field (column) name; unique within the entity.

visibility.description: Explicit audience classification; there is no default.

pii.description: PII marks personal data about the data subject.

secret.description: Secret marks credentials and key material; it implies internal visibility.

erasure.description: Erasure is the strategy applied when the data subject is erased.

retain_reason.description: RetainReason is required when Erasure is 'retain'.

export.description: Export includes the field in data-subject access exports.

title: Data Catalog
description: Entities and fields an application stores, and how each is classified.
